title: Long Exposure: Accelerating Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for LLMs under Shadowy Sparsity
problem: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) for LLMs is inefficient in terms of computational time and operational costs. A distinctive form of sparsity called Shadowy Sparsity emerges during fine-tuning but has not been adequately addressed for acceleration.
motivation: Efficient adaptation of pre-trained LLMs to diverse downstream tasks is critical for numerous applications but faces significant challenges in time investment and operational costs.
method: Long Exposure consists of three key components: Shadowy-sparsity Exposer employs prolonged sensing to capture fine-grained sparsity patterns, Sequence-oriented Predictor provides efficient predictions for large sequence inputs and constantly-evolving parameters, and Dynamic-aware Operator facilitates structured computational patterns and coalesced memory accesses for dynamic sparse operations.
key_novelty: Identification and exploitation of Shadowy Sparsity, a distinctive form of sparsity in LLM fine-tuning, combined with a specialized system design to accelerate PEFT.
contributions: Introduction of Shadowy Sparsity concept for fine-tuning
Long Exposure system with three specialized acceleration components
Shadowy-sparsity Exposer for prolonged sparsity sensing
Efficient sequence-oriented prediction and dynamic-aware execution for sparse fine-tuning
primary_theme: Sparsity-aware acceleration for parameter-efficient LLM fine-tuning
